verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a billing API platform like Lago, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents an API, an OpenAPI schema and an MCP server that gives AI assistants access to billing data, but nothing about issuing API keys with restricted scopes, permissions or least-privilege access for an agent. Agent access alone is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
